title: Made a thing where you describe the game you want to play and then you just play it
author: Spookie_Stunkk
selftext:
Ever had a game idea and thought "someone should make that"? That's the whole reason this exists: [https://dreamsy.dev/](https://dreamsy.dev/)

You type the game you want to play. A minute later you're playing it. Then you keep messing with it: "make the guards pigeons", "make it rain", "swap the music for something spookier". Sprites, music, backgrounds, levels, the actual game code, all of it is editable. Nothing's locked in.

Some I made something this week:  
What's in it:

* **21 kits** (15 genres like platformer, tower defense, farming, roguelite, racing, plus 6 base kits) so games actually play well instead of being a janky one-off
* **Chiptune music** that gets composed for your game, and you can edit it note by note
* **Runs on web, iOS and Android**, on our own C++ engine compiled to WebAssembly
* **Game logic is in Luau**, so if you can code, you can open it up and change anything
* **Share links**: publish a game, send the link, anyone can play it or remix it

**MCP:** there's an MCP server, so you can build games straight from Claude, Codex or Cursor. Your agent makes the game, playtests it, sees screenshots, and fixes what's broken. I built most of the games above that way.

Source is on GitHub: [github.com/apoorvcodes/dreamsy](http://github.com/apoorvcodes/dreamsy)

Would love to know what you'd make with it. Drop a game idea in the comments and I'll build a few and reply with the links.

It's still a work in concept and hence the games themselves are pretty simple but I want this to eventually evolve into something much more powerful.
